meetings.summary: Converged on framework-as-package (Luiz): a portable module dropped into a repo that ingests unstructured resources into an ontology-structured knowledge base, articulated with the live site (two pages integrated on regen-toolkit-os: Toolkit Framework + Regen-Toolkit-OS). Funding: no feedback yet on Regen Coordination budget/scope; expects a hunk of the QF distribution; not rushing. Next checkpoint ~2 weeks.
decisions: Framework-as-package is the adopted build direction (portable module → agents process resources → ontology-structured KB); initial testable version ~2 weeks

meetings.title: Toolkit Work Session with Matty — RegenOS + Knowledge Commons Architecture
meetings.transcript_path: packages/operations/meetings/260615 Toolkit Work Session with Matty.md
meetings.summary: Ad-hoc 1-on-1 (Matty + Luiz). Matty walked through master-doc artifacts (two GPT handoff docs, next working draft, structure-options doc, unified resource index); Luiz demoed the OrgOS overlay end-to-end and articulated RegenOS as the federation layer above OrgOS instances. Two strategic moves converged: (1) formally split into a domain-agnostic framework + ReFi Web3 Toolkit as its first instance; (2) house the toolkit under ReFi Commons with a standards + funding model. Knowledge-source vs organizational federation likely two distinct mechanisms. Self-qualifying adoption = non-arbitrary curation filter. Simplify infra first (GitHub+agents now; Radicle/COI/on-chain later). Coordination via small bites + standards stack (CIDS + DAO IP5 + impact accounting tied to funding flows); scale to 5-7 high-trust orgs, not open chapter calls. Matty's compensation preference: seed an Impact Vault for the knowledge commons. Matty + Luiz named as the two to drive this forward.
decisions: Formally split the work into a domain-agnostic framework + the ReFi Web3 Toolkit as its first concrete instance (master doc currently conflates the two)
Explore housing the toolkit under ReFi Commons as its organizational home (Matty: 'Oh yeah, 100%'); Green Pill IP likely rolls fully into ReFi Commons; be giving/trusting on IP
RegenOS gets a concrete written description (currently only vaguely referenced) — coordination layer above OrgOS instances mapping upstream/downstream repo relationships
Knowledge-source federation and organizational federation are probably two distinct mechanisms, not one
Self-qualifying adoption (adopt the framework + go through the process) is the non-arbitrary filtering function for deeper federation
Do not settle final infra / on-chain storage now — simplify first (GitHub + agents), layer complexity (Radicle, COI, on-chain) later
Coordination model: small bites not a big merger; standards stack = CIDS + DAO IP5 + impact accounting tied to funding flows; impact measurement specific + academically rigorous
Scale to ~5-7 more existing high-trust orgs / known people, not open chapter calls
Matty's compensation preference: seed an Impact Vault ('Oct and Vault') for the knowledge commons rather than take funding personally
Next master-doc iteration mechanics: AI-native verbose draft → group feedback → checkpoint; ~3 structural variants as the eventual target
